intake_caller_surfaces.native_spoken: ग्यारह बजने में पाँच मिनट हैं
intake_caller_surfaces.romanized_spoken: gyaarah bajne mein paanch minute hain
intake_caller_surfaces.rationale: Uses ordinary Hindi minutes-before phrasing: the listener must resolve five minutes before eleven to 10:55, unlike the Easy controls that use direct whole/quarter/half forms such as साढ़े दस or पौने ग्यारह. Asking for the day period supplies the omitted morning marker and distinguishes it from 10:55 PM.

intake_caller_surfaces.rationale: Uses a natural minutes-before expression requiring interpretation as five minutes before five, yielding 4:55, rather than the Easy controls' more conventional direct quarter/half/whole-hour surfaces.
